summary: Iter 76 — Brevo per-organization lists (Staff/Collaboratori/Utenti_invitati/Volontari/Referenti_Aziendali). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter76_brevo_org_lists.py: (1) GET /settings 403 for org admin + default enabled=false + configured flag + folder 'CRMEvent · Organizzazioni' + unchanged_lists contains the 4 preserved lists, (2) PUT /settings toggles value and writes audit 'brevo_org_lists_toggle' in audit_logs collection, (3) GET /preview returns the 5 categories in order with correct {slug(nome)}_{Label} naming and counts validated against DB (staff/collab/volontari via staff presences+persons, referenti via person_companies + legacy azienda_id, utenti_invitati via active memberships excluding org owner_user_id + non-superadmin users), (4) POST /sync returns 400 'Attiva prima…' when disabled and 400 'Brevo non configurato' when enabled but no Brevo key, (5) Unit test with a fully-mocked BrevoClient (no network): sync_org creates folder only once, creates list only for categories with contacts, stores brevo_org_lists {org_id,category,list_id,list_name}; second run reuses list_id (no new list, all contacts counted 'gia_presente'); new contact → create_contact; contact marked listUnsubscribed is counted 'disiscritto' and NOT re-added, (6) sync_invited_user adds only to utenti_invitati and does not touch staff person, (7) server.sync_registered_user: for a user that is not self_registered and not owner_user_id, source='invite_accepted'/'profile_edit' returns skipped reason='invited'; source='registration' does NOT return reason='invited'. Frontend (SA /marketing/brevo): all required data-testids present — org-lists-panel, org-lists-unchanged (contains Lead/Prospect/Utenti registrati/Disponibilità eventi), org-lists-toggle, org-lists-org, org-lists-no-key notice (BREVO not configured), 5 preview cards org-list-{staff|collaboratori|utenti_invitati|volontari|referenti_aziendali} with org-list-count-* (QA org: 5/0/4/3/0), sync button org-lists-sync disabled (toggle off + Brevo not configured). Mobile 390px: horizontal overflow = 0px. Toggle left DISABLED at end of all tests.
critical_code_review_comments: brevo_org_lists.org_members: the referenti_aziendali query uses persons.azienda_id {$nin:[None,'']}; this includes any person with azienda_id set regardless of whether that azienda_id still points to an existing company. Low risk because the preview and sync both dedupe by email, but if a person was previously linked to a company via legacy azienda_id and then re-assigned, they may still be counted. Consider also filtering azienda_id against actual company IDs for the org.
sync_org inserts into brevo_org_sync_log on every run (even when toggle disabled is prevented at router level, but direct calls to sync_org don't check). Not an issue in practice but worth noting.

seed_data_creation: Unit tests create ephemeral motor DBs 'brevo_orglists_selftest_<rand>' and 'brevo_regsync_selftest_<rand>' and drop them after each test. The production 'test_database' is only read via a module-level audit assertion; no TEST_ documents are persisted into it. Toggle brevo_org_lists_enabled is explicitly set back to False in a module-scoped teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit collection is 'audit_logs' (plural) — not 'audit_log'. Preview counts for QA org (org_qa_eventi) at the time of this run: staff=5, collaboratori=0, utenti_invitati=4, volontari=3, referenti_aziendali=0. BrevoClient is a context-managed class; the fake in-memory client used in unit tests must implement __aenter__/__aexit__ and only folders/create_folder/create_list/get_contact/create_contact/add_existing_to_list are called by brevo_org_lists.sync_org — no need to mock lists()/update_contact(). To mock sync in unit tests, patch brevo_client.BrevoClient (not an attribute of brevo_org_lists) because brevo_org_lists imports the module. The /platform/brevo/org-lists/* router prefix is already '/api/platform/brevo/org-lists' (set in brevo_org_lists.build_router). No real Brevo call was ever made.
